source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ευθύμιος Πατριάρχης Ιεροσολύμων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **No year at all is printed**, so there is no `dates` object and nothing dates him. **He is none of the corpus's twenty-odd Euthymii**: the see is the only thing the page gives him, and no other Euthymius in the corpus is a patriarch of Jerusalem. The page says he is absent from the compilers of the synaxaria and from the Menaia, and that his memory is met in the Hierosolymitan Kanonarion.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
